en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a sloped path running beside a stone wall and stream. A boy in early 20th‑century clothing stands on the path. Above the path are plastered stone buildings with steep, tiled roofs typical of Central European historic towns. A wooden picket fence lines the upper side of the path, while trees and dense vegetation frame the scene. In the background, a timber‑framed house is partially visible beyond the wall.
